# blink

> Send text or JSON state with typed questions and get probabilities for every option in one forward pass, with no generated text.

blink supports yes/no (`noul`), choice, and ordered score questions. The server is wire-compatible with TypeSafe's API. The Space accepts the same fields through its Gradio API.

## Docs

- [API](https://thegovind.github.io/blink/api.md): Endpoints, requests, responses, limits, and clients.
- [Agent experience](https://thegovind.github.io/blink/agents.md): Skill setup and agent-facing docs.
- [Models](https://thegovind.github.io/blink/models.md): Available models and model cards.
